authorization: User requested E1/E2/E3 Q5 equal-weight, 1-week/2-week/1-month sensitivity and complete report
training: reuse all original sealed predictions; no retraining
seed_selection: E1 fixed; E2/E3 fixed equal ensemble of 17/42/2026

frequencies.two_weeks: W-FRI calendar-week distance from initial signal week divisible by 2; empty holiday weeks do not reset phase
frequencies.one_month: first available weekly signal of each natural calendar month, not every 4 weeks and not exact month-end

execution: next actual market-session open; no intervening retargeting or retry of failed orders
portfolio: original Q5 floor(5*ordinal/N)==4, ascending score then instrument; target equal weight; cash and legacy positions retained on failed fills
main_valuation: suspend_flat, continuing preceding disclosed net-excess diagnostic
mark_rule: Only verified full-day suspension permits last observed qfq-close mark for <=20 sessions; haircut20 applies 20% haircut; no invented corporate-action terminal value; strict branch uses actual quotes only
benchmark_clock: initial signal close, strategy capital in cash until next open; no total-return open imputation
comparison: main common end=min available account end across 9 suspend_flat/main combinations; common across 27 flat cost branches separately; global common across all 54 proxy-valuation branches separately; native intervals separately; no cherry-picked end dates
yearly: calendar returns on common and available intervals; blocked years explicit, no zero returns after failure

uncertainty.method: circular paired time blocks of 65 market sessions, 2000 replicates, seed20261116; interval for annualized mean daily active return, not CAGR

selection: report every 3x3 combination; no optimizer chooses model/frequency
